prompt: What is the strongest conclusion the team can draw about panel 2 that morning?
promptZh: 就當天早上 2 號玻璃板的情況，這組志工最能合理得出什麼結論？

options.text: Exactly one bird touched panel 2 during the whole session.
options.zh: 整段觀察時段恰好有一隻鳥碰到 2 號板。
options.whyZh: 一段時間內看不到 2 號板，因此無法保證整段時段只有一次。

options.text: At least one strike was observed, but part of the session is unaccounted for.
options.zh: 觀察到至少一次撞擊，但有一段時段無法確定。
options.whyZh: 麻雀碰到 2 號板是可記錄撞擊；8:41 至 8:47 的遮擋卻不能推斷為零次。

options.text: No strike was observed because the sparrow flew away.
options.zh: 未觀察到撞擊，因為麻雀飛走了。
options.whyZh: 碰到玻璃即符合撞擊定義；之後是否飛走不影響認列。

options.text: Panel 2 had more strikes than panel 4.
options.zh: 2 號板的撞擊比 4 號板多。
options.whyZh: 可確認的兩板各有一次；遮擋期間的未知情形不能用來判定多寡。

explanationZh: 麻雀碰到 2 號板是可記錄撞擊；8:41 至 8:47 的遮擋卻不能推斷為零次。
evidence:
Volunteer field card | Riverglass Bird Rescue
At the east pedestrian bridge, count a bird strike only if you see a bird touch the glass railing. A bird flying past the panel is not a strike. Enter groups of birds as separate sightings if you can tell them apart. Do not collect feathers or handle birds; call the rescue desk if a bird remains on the ground. | Email | Rowan to Saturday volunteers
Use the new wall-side entrance this week; work crews have closed the stairs near the river. Our 8:00–9:00 session stays the same. Have one person watch the glass while the other fills in the sheet. If a crew vehicle blocks your view, write down the start and end of the obstruction instead of guessing what happened. | Field log | Saturday | Ivy and Leon
8:13 Two swallows passed in front of panel 4; both continued across the river.
8:26 One sparrow touched panel 2 and flew away.
8:41–8:47 A maintenance van hid panels 1 and 2.
8:52 One pigeon touched panel 4 and stayed on the ground; Ivy phoned the rescue desk.

vocabulary.zh: 此處指沒有足夠觀察資料可確認
